clause: Interactive components: variant interactions run automatically in every instance [STU-PRO-027]

scope.summary: Implement interactive components: variant-to-variant interactions authored on a variant-set StudioComponent (MT-329) run automatically inside every instance, so hover/press/toggle states work without per-screen wiring. Whether these states and their bound variables reset or persist across navigation is governed by the flow's state-preservation setting (MT-373). This is runtime behavior over the existing variant + trigger/action primitives; no new primitive.
acceptance_criteria: variant interactions run automatically in every instance; state reset/persist honors flow setting; no new primitive
expected_tests: live: variant interactions authored on a variant set run automatically in every instance without per-screen wiring; reset/persist honors flow setting

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No interactive components; common states must be re-wired per screen.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
